description: This file contains functions and constants related to message summarization, chunking, and context management for an AI agent, including fallback strategies and token estimation.

methods.name: resolveIdentifierPreservationInstructions
methods.description: Determines the instructions for preserving identifiers based on policy.

methods.name: buildCompactionSummarizationInstructions
methods.description: Constructs summarization instructions, combining custom and default policies.

methods.name: estimateMessagesTokens
methods.description: Estimates total tokens in a list of messages, excluding tool result details.

methods.name: estimateCompactionMessageTokens
methods.description: Estimates tokens for a single message.

methods.name: normalizeParts
methods.description: Normalizes the number of parts for splitting messages.

methods.name: splitMessagesByTokenShare
methods.description: Splits messages into chunks based on token share, respecting boundaries for assistant and tool result messages.

methods.name: chunkMessagesByMaxTokens
methods.description: Chunks messages into segments not exceeding a max token count, with safety margin.

methods.name: computeAdaptiveChunkRatio
methods.description: Calculates adaptive chunk ratio based on message size and context window.

methods.name: isOversizedForSummary
methods.description: Checks if a message is too large to summarize safely.

methods.name: summarizeChunks
methods.description: Generates a summary from message chunks, with retries and instructions.

methods.name: generateSummary
methods.description: Calls the appropriate summary generation function, with compatibility handling.

methods.name: summarizeWithFallback
methods.description: Performs summarization with fallback strategies for oversized messages or failures.

methods.name: summarizeInStages
methods.description: Performs staged summarization by splitting messages into parts and merging partial summaries.

methods.name: pruneHistoryForContextShare
methods.description: Reduces message history to fit within token budget for context sharing, repairing tool message pairing.

methods.name: resolveContextWindowTokens
methods.description: Resolves the token count for the model's context window.
